content_zh:
女帝刚刚洗浴完，此时女帝还是二皇女......　　【pS：之前已写过一本50万人在读的书籍，相信本人实力，并且，每出一个女性角色都会配图，请兄弟们放心入坑】
……
德宣五十三年，三月初，京都镇东侯府一偏院。
初春，笼罩京都整个冬季的大雪刚刚消融不久，天空中依旧寒风刺骨。
夏辰衣着单薄，于寒风中挥洒汗水，练刀不辍。
他清秀俊朗的面孔上一片潮红，气血之力不断翻涌，眼神中透出坚韧之色。
夏辰手握长刀，刀身一片赤红，在虚空中斩出道道涟漪，仿佛要将寒风切割开来。
随着他每次挥舞，在他的视野范围内冒出一行小字。
【成功挥舞一次，基础刀法熟练度+1】
【成功挥舞一次，基础刀法熟练度+1】
【成功挥舞一次，基础刀法熟练度+1】
……
【基础刀法圆满，你于基础刀法中领悟进阶刀法——首阳破魔刀！】
【你的气血值已达到九品巅峰，是否立刻突破？】
随着这些小字冒出来，夏辰俊朗的小脸上露出喜色，他手中的赤红长刀这一刻也变了，体内的气血仿佛在剧烈的沸腾翻涌，丝丝缕缕的气血竟然透过了他的身体，在他的身后凝聚出了一轮赤红大日。
这轮大日好似天地初开的首阳，划开混沌黑暗，充满生机与炽烈。
在这轮大日的加持下，夏辰浑身剧烈颤抖，整个人宛如岩浆一般，气血之力到达顶峰，仿佛要焚江煮海！
这个过程并没有持续太久，夏辰目光凌厉，还有些稚嫩的脸庞透露着严肃，他一刀挥出，整片院子仿佛由寒冬来到了初夏。
一刀，改天换地！
与此同时，只听见咔嚓一声，夏辰体内传来一声声响，仿佛一道无形的枷锁断裂，浑身沸腾的气血之力仿佛找到了宣泄口，如长江东奔大海，而这一刻，夏辰气势到达顶峰。

八品炼精境已成！
夏辰缓缓睁开双眼，眸子中有精光闪烁，隐约间，似乎有两个眸子合二为一，宛如重瞳。
但这种异象转瞬即逝，夏辰整个人恢复平静，气势收敛，化为一个普通少年人。
“来到这个世界已经有两个月了，终于突破到八品境了！”
夏辰嘴角浮现一股笑意，两个月前，他便发现，自己提前进入了那个神秘游戏的早期版本中。
上辈子它突然的出现在地球上，无人知晓这个游戏的来历，只知道一些幸运儿被选中，可以进入这个宛如真实的世界中。
此时，正是大武文帝时期，对于这个时期，夏辰并不太了解，因为，夏辰提前进入了这款游戏中，而等游戏开服内测，那已经是女帝时期了。
“现在是文帝二龙夺嫡时期，五年后，三皇子政变，带兵杀入京城，打开白虎门，杀进宫内，太子身死，三皇子杀到癫狂，将所有皇室血脉屠戮殆尽，但最后的赢家却并不是他！”
夏辰在理清脉络，回忆这段时期发生的剧情，但可惜，前世夏辰是第一次公测时期才进入的这方世界，那时候女帝已经登基六年了。
所以，夏辰对于这段过往并没有去深入了解，只知道一个大概脉络。
这个时期争锋看似是二龙夺嫡，但实则还有一头隐龙隐藏在暗处，五年后夺门之变，二皇女奇兵天降，手握太祖剑，带领着骑兵杀入了白虎门中。
那一夜，整座皇宫喊杀声不断，鲜血将漫天白雪都给染红了，最后，二皇女平定所有叛军。
但文帝，太子，三皇子还有所有皇室男性直系血脉全都在这场夺门之变中被屠戮殆尽，身死当场。
最终，大武迎来了第一位女帝，一个辉煌的时代开启了……

The empress has just finished taking a bath. At this time, the empress is still the second princess... [pS: I have written a book that is read by 500,000 people before. I believe in my ability, and every female character will be accompanied by a picture, so brothers, please feel free to enter]
…
In the early March of the fifty-third year of Dexuan, there was a branch courtyard of Donghou Mansion in Kyoto Town.
In early spring, the heavy snow that had shrouded Kyoto throughout the winter had just melted away, and the wind was still biting in the sky.
Xia Chen was wearing thin clothes, sweating in the cold wind, and kept practicing his sword.
His delicate and handsome face was flushed, the power of Qi and blood was constantly surging, and there was a look of tenacity in his eyes.
Xia Chen held a long knife in his hand, the blade was red, and he cut ripples in the void, as if he wanted to cut through the cold wind.
With each wave of his hand, a line of small words appeared in his field of vision.
[Successfully swing once, basic sword skill proficiency +1]
[Successfully swing once, basic sword skill proficiency +1]
[Successfully swing once, basic sword skill proficiency +1]
…
[Basic sword skills are perfect, you can understand the advanced sword skills in the basic sword skills - Shouyang Demon Breaking Sword! 】
[Your energy and blood value has reached the peak of the ninth level. Do you want to break through immediately? 】
As these small words appeared, Xia Chen's handsome little face showed joy. The red long knife in his hand also changed at this moment. The energy and blood in his body seemed to be violently boiling and surging. Wisps of energy and blood actually penetrated his body, and a red sun condensed behind him.
This great sun is like the first rising sun of heaven and earth, cutting through the chaos and darkness, full of vitality and blazing energy.
Under the blessing of this great sun, Xia Chen's whole body trembled violently, his whole body was like lava, and the power of his energy and blood reached its peak, as if he was about to burn the river and boil the sea!
This process did not last long. Xia Chen's eyes were sharp, and his childish face showed seriousness. He swung the knife, and the whole yard seemed to have turned from cold winter to early summer.
One knife, change the world!
At the same time, there was only a click, and a sound came from Xia Chen's body, as if an invisible shackle was broken. The boiling energy and blood in his body seemed to have found an outlet, like the Yangtze River rushing eastward to the sea. At this moment, Xia Chen's momentum reached its peak.
The eighth-grade refinement realm has been achieved!
Xia Chen slowly opened his eyes, and there was a flash of light in his eyes. It seemed that there were two eyes that merged into one, like double pupils.
But this vision passed quickly, and Xia Chen regained his composure, his aura subdued, and turned into an ordinary young man.
"It has been two months since I came to this world, and I finally broke through to the eighth level!"
A smile appeared on Xia Chen's lips. Two months ago, he discovered that he had entered the early version of the mysterious game in advance.
It suddenly appeared on the earth in the last life. No one knows the origin of this game. They only know that some lucky people are selected to enter this real world.
At this time, it was the period of Emperor Dawu Wen. Xia Chen didn't know much about this period, because Xia Chen entered the game in advance, and by the time the game was launched for internal testing, it would already be the period of the Empress.
"Now is the period when Emperor Wen's two dragons are seizing the throne. Five years later, the third prince made a coup, led his troops into the capital, opened the White Tiger Gate, and entered the palace. The prince died, and the third prince went crazy and slaughtered all the royal blood, but the final winner was not him!"
Xia Chen was sorting out the context and recalling the plot that happened during this period, but unfortunately, in his previous life, Xia Chen only entered this world during the first public beta period. At that time, the empress had already ascended the throne for six years.
Therefore, Xia Chen did not have a deep understanding of this past and only knew a general outline.
During this period, the fight seemed to be about two dragons seizing the throne, but in fact there was still a hidden dragon hiding in the dark. Five years later, during the seizing of the gate, the two princesses descended from the sky, holding the Taizu sword in hand, and led the cavalry into the White Tiger Gate.
That night, the whole palace screamed for murder, and blood filled the sky with snow.They were all dyed red. In the end, the second princess put down all the rebels.
However, Emperor Wen, the Crown Prince, the Third Prince and all the direct male bloodlines of the royal family were all slaughtered in this coup and died on the spot.
Finally, Dawu ushered in its first female emperor, and a glorious era began...
